subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When a caller invokes the host persistence adapter, it may supply the protected review-obligation/review-process/publication-attempt/proposal/revision binding and non-secret attempt-proof reference and consume the returned native receipt, but it shall neither perform a proposal write nor define, fork, or reinterpret impl-review's report schema.
rationale: sibling integration must not create a second publisher or artifact contract
fit_criterion: contract and implementation inspection find one impl-review-owned report schema and publisher; the host seam contains only typed binding, invocation, distinct proof-reference supply and receipt consumption, verification, and FR-35's field-identical reciprocal event join; both-media goldens remain owned by impl-review
